channel.title: Wire — React
channel.description: React from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: React Simple Maps 5.0: Composable SVG Maps for React Apps
item.description: Create beautiful SVG map charts in React with d3-geo and TopoJSON using a declarative api. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: Astryx 0.6: Meta's React Design System Gets Responsive Themes
item.description: Responsive theme rules, a Selector that can choose the right surface, Neutral’s visual makeover, six new templates, and a specification-backed path toward v1. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: ilamy Calendar 3.0
item.description: A lightweight, highly pluggable React calendar component built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. A small ~13 KB gzipped core with opt-in plugins (recurring events, agenda) so you only ship what you use. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: React Native Skia 2.12
item.description: High-performance React Native Graphics using Skia. Contribute to Shopify/react-native-skia development by creating an account on GitHub. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: unveiled a 'flat rate' CDN pricing option
item.description: Flat Rate CDN gives Vercel Pro teams a fixed monthly CDN bill with built-in spike protection and no overages. (1 source: reactstatus)
